# Spring Boot service — golden-path scaffold generated by Makeway

## Layout

```
.
├── pom.xml
├── src/main/java/io/makeway/
│   ├── Application.java      # @SpringBootApplication
│   └── HealthController.java # exposes / and /health
├── setup.sh                  # golden-path setup (mvn package)
├── Dockerfile                # eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine, port 8080
└── .github/workflows/        # CI runs on merge to main (placed at repo root)
```

## Run locally

```bash
./setup.sh
java -jar target/makeway-spring-service-0.1.0.jar
```

## Health

`GET /health` → `{"status": "healthy"}`
